ko.title: [부동산 101 #13] 부동산 중개인 비용은 누가 실제로 부담하며, 법적으로 고객에게 무엇을 입증해야 하는가

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > 부동산 중개인의 업무는 세 가지 문서와 하나의 서명으로 정의됩니다. 중개인을 고용하는 계약서, 수수료를 지급하는 조항, 그리고 모두가 법정에 서지 않도록 보호하는 정보 공개 서류입니다.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 식당 웨이터를 만나듯 부동산 중개인을 만납니다. 친절한 누군가가 나타나 매물을 보여주고, 마지막에 영수증이 제시되는 방식이죠.

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: 이러한 고정관념은 잘못되었으며, 주 부동산 위원회에 접수되는 거의 모든 민원의 원인이 됩니다.

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: 부동산 중개 실무는 세 가지 기둥 위에 서 있습니다.

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: 관계를 형성하는 계약서.**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: 중개인은 단지 친절하게 대한다고 해서 당신을 대리하는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: 당신이 서명했기 때문에 당신을 대리하는 것입니다.

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: 매도인 측에서는 이것이 **매도 중개 계약서(listing agreement)**이며, 매수인 측에서는 **매수인 대리 계약서(buyer representation agreement)**입니다.

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: 대부분의 주에서 법적 효력을 가지려면 이 계약들이 반드시 서면으로 작성되어야 하며(*사기방지법(statute of frauds)*의 결과), 구체적인 만료일이 명시되어야 합니다. 기한 없는 계약은 허용되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: 매도 중개 계약에는 여러 유형이 있으며, 그 차이는 실질적인 돈의 차이로 이어집니다.

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **독점 매도권(Exclusive right to sell)** — 계약 기간 동안 집이 팔리면, 매도인의 사촌을 포함해 *누가 매수인을 찾았든 관계없이* 매도 중개인에게 수수료가 지급됩니다. 이것이 미국의 표준 매도 중개 방식입니다.

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **독점 중개(Exclusive agency)** — 해당 중개인(또는 다른 중개인)이 매수인을 연계한 경우에만 수수료가 지급됩니다. 매도인이 직접 매수인을 찾은 경우 수수료는 없습니다.

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **일반 중개(Open listing)** — 매도인이 여러 중개인을 고용할 수 있으며, 실제로 매수인을 연계한 중개인만 수수료를 받습니다. 주택 거래에서는 드뭅니다.

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: 수수료 지급 조항.**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: 중개 수수료는 *항상 협상 가능하며, 법적으로도 그래야 합니다.* 어떤 주, 협회, MLS(다중 매물 등록 서비스)도 표준 요율을 정하거나 제안할 수 없으며, 그렇게 하는 것은 연방 반트러스트법에 따른 가격 담합에 해당합니다.

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: 다만 누가 누구에게 지급하느냐가 달라지는데, 미국 부동산중개인협회(NAR)의 합의에 따른 실무 변경 사항이 **2024년 8월 17일**부터 시행되면서 전국적으로 두 가지가 바뀌었습니다. 매수인 중개인에 대한 수수료 제공 제안을 더 이상 MLS에 게시할 수 없게 되었고, MLS 참여 중개인은 매수인과 함께 집을 둘러보기 *전에* 서명된 서면 계약을 체결해야 합니다.

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: 매도인이 매수인 중개인 수수료를 부담하기로 합의하는 것은 여전히 가능하지만, 이제는 매물 목록에 광고하는 것이 아니라 거래 계약 과정에서 협상됩니다.

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: 의무, 그리고 중개인이 소송을 당하는 이유.**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: 중개인이 (중립적인 거래 중재자가 아니라) 대리인으로서 당신을 대리할 때, 그들은 **수임인 의무(fiduciary duties)**를 집니다. 충실 의무, 비밀유지 의무, 합법적 지시 이행 의무, 중요한 사실 공개 의무, 합리적 주의 의무, 그리고 맡겨진 자금에 대한 회계 보고 의무입니다.

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: 수수료가 업무의 즐거운 부분이라면, 이러한 의무들은 소송을 부르는 부분입니다.

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: 반복되는 위반 유형은 따분할 정도로 일관됩니다. 알려진 중요한 결함을 공개하지 않는 것, 자격증 없이 법률이나 감정평가 자문을 하는 것("걱정 마세요, 그 지역권은 문제없습니다"), 계약금 관리 부실, 그리고 **미공개 양타 중개(undisclosed dual agency)**(서면 동의 없이 양측을 모두 대리하는 행위)입니다.

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: 일부 주에서는 이러한 이해충돌을 관리할 수 없다고 판단하여 양타 중개를 전면 금지했습니다. 예를 들어 플로리다와 콜로라도는 대신 중립적인 **거래 중개인(transaction broker)** 모델을 사용합니다.

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: 이것이 바로 중개법인이 **과실 및 누락 보험(E&O insurance)**에 가입하는 이유이며, 모든 문자 메시지, 공개 서류, 서명된 첨부 서류 등의 서류 파일이 중개인의 진정한 방어 수단이 되는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: 노스캐롤라이나주 롤리에 있는 타운하우스를 **$425,000**에 판다고 가정해 봅시다.

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: 당신은 협상된 **총 5% 수수료**로 6개월 기간의 독점 매도권 계약을 체결하고, 매수인 중개인이 개입될 경우 그 수수료의 **2.5%**를 제공하는 것을 중개 계약서에 승인합니다.

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: 잔금 지급일:

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: 그 $10,625는 당신의 담당 중개인에게 직접 가지 않습니다.

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: 그것은 **중개법인(broker)**에게 지급되며, 중개법인은 내부 계약에 따라 담당 중개인과 나누게 됩니다. 신규 중개인과의 50/50 배분이라면 프랜차이즈 수수료, MLS 분납금, 마케팅 비용, 자영업세를 차감하기 전에 $5,312.50가 남습니다.

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: 이 구조를 이해하면 협상 방식이 달라집니다. 당신은 $21,250를 챙기는 개인과 협상하는 것이 아니라, 고정 비용이 존재하는 사업체와 협상하고 있는 것입니다.

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: 이제 실제로 문제가 될 수 있는 부분들입니다.

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **4개월 차:** 이웃이 직접 집을 사겠다고 제안합니다.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: *독점 매도권(exclusive right to sell)* 계약에 따르면, 당신의 중개법인은 여전히 수수료를 받을 권리가 있습니다.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: *독점 중개(exclusive agency)* 계약이었다면 수수료를 주지 않아도 됩니다.

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: 건성으로 읽은 계약서 속 단어 하나 차이가 $21,250의 차이를 만들어 냅니다.

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **5개월 차:** 당신의 중개인이 자신이 대리하고 있는 다른 매수인을 데려옵니다.

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: 노스캐롤라이나주에서는 양측의 사전 서면 동의가 있어야만 이것이 합법이며, 중개인은 가격 및 조건에 대해 어느 한쪽에도 자문하는 것을 중단해야 합니다.

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: 만약 이를 물어보지 않고 진행했다면 — 이는 자격정지 사유에 해당하는 민원 대상입니다.

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **잔금 지급일:** 당신은 잔금 담당 변호사로부터 온 것과 똑같이 생긴 이메일을 받습니다. 변경된 송금 지침과 "급히 처리해 달라"는 메모가 적혀 있습니다.

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: 이것은 현대 주택 부동산 거래에서 가장 큰 돈이 들어가는 실수입니다.

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: FBI 인터넷범죄신고센터에는 매년 수천 건의 부동산 송금 사기 신고가 접수되며, 피해액은 수억 달러에 달하고 송금된 자금은 몇 시간 만에 회수 불가능해지는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **절대로 이메일로 온 송금 지침을 그대로 받아들이지 마세요.** 이메일에 적힌 번호가 아니라 직접 찾아본 번호로 잔금 처리 사무소에 전화하여 모든 숫자를 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. 중개 관계 — 그리고 당신의 이익을 보호할 의무 — 는 악수가 아니라 서명된 매도 중개 계약서나 매수인 대리 계약서로부터 시작됩니다.

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. 수수료는 법적으로 협상 가능하며, *중개법인*에 지급된 후 배분됩니다. 2024년 8월 이후 수수료는 MLS에 공시되는 대신 거래 내부에서 협상됩니다.

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. 중개 거래 관련 사고의 대부분은 미리 예방할 수 있는 서류상의 문제입니다. 미공개 양타 중개 방지, 중요한 결함의 문서화, 전화로 재확인한 송금 지침 등이 핵심입니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing.
segments.tr: **Q1.** 당신은 6개월 기간의 **독점 매도권(exclusive right to sell)** 계약을 체결했습니다.

segments.src: In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own.
segments.tr: 3개월 차에 당신은 순전히 스스로 매수인을 찾아냈습니다.

segments.src: Does the listing broker earn a commission?
segments.tr: 매도 중개법인은 수수료를 받을 자격이 있습니까?

segments.src: - (A) Yes, the full negotiated commission
segments.tr: - (A) 네, 협상된 수수료 전액을 받습니다

segments.src: - (B) No, because the broker didn't produce the buyer
segments.tr: - (B) 아니요, 중개인이 매수인을 찾지 않았기 때문입니다

segments.src: - (C) Only half, automatically
segments.tr: - (C) 자동으로 절반만 받습니다

segments.src: (O/X)** Since the August 2024 practice changes, U.S.
segments.tr: (O/X)** 2024년 8월 실무 변경 이후, 미국의

segments.src: real estate commissions follow a standard national rate set by the industry.
segments.tr: 부동산 중개 수수료는 업계가 정한 표준 전국 요율을 따릅니다.

segments.src: **Q3.** Two days before closing you receive an email from your title company with new wire instructions.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 잔금일 이틀 전, 당신은 소유권 회사(title company)로부터 새로운 송금 지침이 담긴 이메일을 받았습니다.

segments.src: What's the correct move?
segments.tr: 올바른 대처법은 무엇입니까?

segments.src: - (A) Reply to the email asking them to confirm
segments.tr: - (A) 확인을 요청하는 답장 이메일을 보낸다

segments.src: - (B) Call the title company at a number you independently verified and confirm the instructions
segments.tr: - (B) 직접 확인한 전화번호로 소유권 회사에 전화하여 지침을 재확인한다

segments.src: - (C) Wire a small test amount first, then the rest
segments.tr: - (C) 소액을 먼저 테스트로 송금한 뒤 나머지를 송금한다

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
segments.tr: - **Listing agreement (매도 중개 계약)** — 매도인이 매물을 마케팅하기 위해 중개법인을 고용하는 서면 계약서로, 기간, 가격, 수수료 등을 명시합니다.

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell (독점 매도권)** — 매수인을 누구 찾았든 상관없이 계약 기간 중 매매가 이루어지면 중개법인에 수수료가 지급되는 중개 유형입니다.

segments.src: - **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
segments.tr: - **Buyer representation agreement (매수인 대리 계약)** — 매수인을 대리하도록 중개법인을 고용하는 서면 계약서입니다. 2024년 8월 17일부터 MLS 참여 중개인과 집을 투어하기 전에 필수 작성해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
segments.tr: - **Fiduciary duty (수임인 의무)** — 중개인이 고객에게 지는 법적 의무로 충실, 비밀유지, 복종, 공개, 합리적 주의, 회계 보고 의무 등이 포함됩니다.

segments.src: - **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
segments.tr: - **Dual agency (양타 중개 / 쌍방 대리)** — 하나의 중개법인이 매수인과 매도인 모두를 대리하는 것으로, 일부 주에서는 서면 정보동의하에 허용되며 다른 주에서는 금지됩니다.

segments.src: - **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.
segments.tr: - **E&O insurance (과실 및 누락 보험)** — 전문적인 과실이나 허위 진술 청구로부터 중개법인을 보호하는 보험입니다.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — (A).** "Exclusive right to sell" means the commission is earned on any sale during the term; a seller who wants a carve-out for self-found buyers needs an exclusive agency listing or a negotiated exclusion clause written into the contract.
segments.tr: *정답: **Q1 — (A).** "독점 매도권"은 계약 기간 중 발생하는 모든 매매에 대해 수수료 청구권이 발생함을 의미합니다. 직접 찾은 매수인을 예외로 두고 싶은 매도인은 독점 중개 계약을 체결하거나 계약서에 예외 조항을 협상하여 명시해야 합니다.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** Rates have never been standardized — setting or suggesting a uniform rate is price fixing under antitrust law.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (False).** 수수료 요율은 단 한 번도 표준화된 적이 없습니다. 통일된 요율을 설정하거나 제안하는 것은 반트러스트법상 가격 담합입니다.

segments.src: The 2024 changes removed compensation offers from the MLS and required written buyer agreements; they did not create a standard rate.
segments.tr: 2024년 변경 사항은 MLS에서 수수료 제공 공시를 삭제하고 매수인 서면 계약을 의무화한 것이지, 표준 요율을 만든 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: **Q3 — (B).** Fraudulent wire instructions arrive from spoofed or compromised email accounts, so replying only reaches the attacker.
segments.tr: **Q3 — (B).** 사기 송금 지침은 이메일 계정을 사칭하거나 해킹하여 발송되므로 답장을 보내면 공격자에게 연결될 뿐입니다.

segments.src: Verify by voice at an independently sourced number; a "test wire" still sends real money to a criminal account.*
segments.tr: 독립적으로 확인한 번호로 음성 통화를 통해 확인하세요. "테스트 송금"을 하더라도 범죄자의 계좌로 실제 돈이 보내지게 됩니다.*

segments.tr: *본 콘텐츠는 일반적인 교육 목적의 내용이며 법적 자문이 아닙니다.

zh.title: [房地产基础 101 #13] 到底是谁在支付经纪人的费用——以及他们在法律上对你负有什么义务

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > 房地产经纪人的工作由三份文件和一个签名决定：聘用他们的协议、支付他们薪酬的条款，以及让所有人远离诉讼的披露声明。

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: 大多数人对待房地产经纪人的态度就像对待服务员一样——一个热情的人出现，带你看各种房源，最后递给你一张账单。

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: 这种思维模型是错误的，也是向州房地产委员会提交的几乎所有投诉的根源。

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: 经纪业务的实践建立在三大支柱之上。

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: 建立代理关系的协议。**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: 经纪人代表你，并不是因为他们对你友好。

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: 他们代表你，是因为你签署了某些文件。

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: 在卖家这边是**独家委托出售协议 (listing agreement)**；在买家这边是**买家代理协议 (buyer representation agreement)**。

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: 在大多数州，这些协议必须以书面形式签署才具有法律约束力（这是*防止欺诈法案 (statute of frauds)* 的要求），并且必须注明明确的到期日——不能有无休止的合同。

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: 房源委托有多种类型，其中的差别涉及真金白银：

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **独家专卖权 (Exclusive right to sell)** — 在合同期内，只要房屋卖出，无论*谁找到买家*（即使是卖家自己的表亲），委托经纪人都会获得佣金。这是美国的标准委托方式。

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **独家代理 (Exclusive agency)** — 只有在经纪人（或另一名经纪人）促成买家的前提下，才支付佣金。如果卖家自己找到了买家，则无需支付佣金。

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **开放式委托 (Open listing)** — 卖家可以聘请多名经纪人；只有促成买家的那位经纪人才能拿到佣金。在住宅市场中很罕见。

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: 薪酬条款。**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: 佣金*总是可以协商的，而且法律规定必须可以协商。* 没有任何州、协会或 MLS 可以设定或建议标准费率——这样做构成联邦反垄断法下的价格垄断行为。

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: 不同之处在于谁向谁支付费用。自美国国家经纪人协会 (NAR) 和解协议的新规于 **2024年8月17日** 生效以来，全国范围内发生了两项重大变革：对买方经纪人的佣金承诺不再允许发布在 MLS 上，并且任何参与 MLS 的经纪人必须在带买家看房*之前*与买家签署书面协议。

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: 卖家仍然可以同意支付买方经纪人的费用——这只是转变为在交易谈判中确定，而不是在房源发布信息中公开展示。

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: 法定义务与经纪人被起诉的方式。**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: 当经纪人作为代理人（而非中立的交易促成者）代表你时，他们承担着**信义义务 (fiduciary duties)**：忠诚、保密、服从合法指令、披露重大事实、尽到合理谨慎责任，以及对所持资金的清算义务。

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: 佣金是这份工作有趣的部分；而这些义务则是引发诉讼的部分。

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: 屡次发生的违规模式惊人地一致：未披露已知的重大瑕疵、无证从事法律或评估业务（“别担心，那个地役权没问题”）、对定金/诚意金的处理粗心大意，以及**未经披露的双重代理 (undisclosed dual agency)** — 即在未获得双方书面知情同意的情况下同时代表买卖双方。

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: 某些州认为这种利益冲突无法调和，因而完全禁止双重代理；例如佛罗里达州和科罗拉多州改用中立的**交易经纪人 (transaction broker)** 模式。

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么经纪公司都会购买**职业疏忽与过失保险 (E&O insurance)**，以及为什么文件档案——每一条短信、每一份披露文件、每一份签署的附加条款——才是经纪人真正的防御武器。

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中的应用

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: 假设你正在北卡罗来纳州罗利市出售一套价值 **$425,000** 的联排别墅。

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: 你签署了一份为期6个月的独家专卖权委托协议，协商好的**总佣金为 5%**，协议中授权你在有买方经纪人参与的情况下，向买方经纪人提供 **2.5%** 的佣金。

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: 在过户结清时：

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: 那 $10,625 并不是直接给你的经纪人。

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: 它是支付给**经纪公司 (broker)** 的，经纪公司再根据内部协议与经纪人分成——如果按照新手经纪人的 50/50 分成，扣除加盟费、MLS 会费、营销成本和自雇税之前，经纪人只能拿到 $5,312.50。

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: 理解这一点会改变你的谈判策略：你是在和一个有成本底线的企业谈判，而不是和一个直接拿走 $21,250 现金的个人谈判。

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: 现在来看看真正刺痛你的部分。

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **第 4 个月：** 你的邻居提出直接购买你的房子。

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: 在*独家专卖权 (exclusive right to sell)* 协议下，你仍然欠经纪公司佣金。

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: 而在*独家代理 (exclusive agency)* 协议下，你不需要支付佣金。

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: 你在粗略浏览合同过程中忽略的一个词，带来了 $21,250 的巨大差别。

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **第 5 个月：** 你的经纪人带来了一个他们同时代表的买家。

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: 在北卡罗来纳州，这只有在事先获得双方书面同意的情况下才合法，并且经纪人必须停止在价格和条款上向任何一方提供建议。

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: 如果他们从未征求过你的同意——这就是可以向执照委员会举报的违规行为。

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **过户日：** 你收到一封看起来与你的过户律师发来的邮件一模一样的邮件，里面有更新后的电汇指令和“请抓紧时间”的提示。

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: 这是现代住宅房地产交易中最昂贵的单一错误。

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: 美国联邦调查局 (FBI) 的互联网犯罪投诉中心每年记录数千起房地产电汇诈骗投诉，损失达数亿美元，并且电汇资金往往在几小时内就无法追回。

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **绝对不要通过电子邮件接受电汇指令。** 务必使用你自己查询到的电话号码（而不是邮件中打印的号码）致电过户办公室，核对每一个数字。

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3行总结

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. 代理关系——以及保护你利益的法律义务——始于签署的委托出售协议或买家代理协议，而不是握手。

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. 佣金依法是可以协商的，支付给*经纪公司*后再进行分成；自 2024 年 8 月起，佣金是在交易内部进行谈判，而不是在 MLS 上公开广告。

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. 大多数房地产经纪灾难都是可以预防的文件文书问题：未经披露的双重代理、未书面记录的重大缺陷，以及需要通过电话确认的电汇指令。

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 随堂小测

segments.src: **Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing.
segments.tr: **Q1.** 你签署了一份为期6个月的**独家专卖权 (exclusive right to sell)** 委托协议。

segments.src: In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own.
segments.tr: 在第 3 个月，你完全靠自己找到了买家。

segments.src: Does the listing broker earn a commission?
segments.tr: 委托经纪人是否有权获得佣金？

segments.src: - (A) Yes, the full negotiated commission
segments.tr: - (A) 是的，获得协商好的全额佣金

segments.src: - (B) No, because the broker didn't produce the buyer
segments.tr: - (B) 否，因为经纪人没有促成买家

segments.src: - (C) Only half, automatically
segments.tr: - (C) 自动只获得一半

segments.src: (O/X)** Since the August 2024 practice changes, U.S.
segments.tr: (O/X)** 自 2024 年 8 月行业规则变更以来，美国的房地产佣金遵循由行业设定的统一全国标准费率。

segments.src: real estate commissions follow a standard national rate set by the industry.
**Q3.** Two days before closing you receive an email from your title company with new wire instructions.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 过户前两天，你收到产权公司发来的包含新电汇指令的电子邮件。

segments.src: What's the correct move?
segments.tr: 正确的做法是什么？

segments.src: - (A) Reply to the email asking them to confirm
segments.tr: - (A) 回复电子邮件要求他们确认

segments.src: - (B) Call the title company at a number you independently verified and confirm the instructions
segments.tr: - (B) 使用你自己独立核实的号码致电产权公司并确认指令

segments.src: - (C) Wire a small test amount first, then the rest
segments.tr: - (C) 先电汇一小笔测试金额，然后再电汇剩余资金

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日词汇

segments.src: - **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
segments.tr: - **Listing agreement (委托出售协议)** — 卖家聘请经纪人推广销售房产的书面合同，其中规定了期限、价格和薪酬。

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell (独家专卖权)** — 一种委托类型，在合同期内无论谁找到买家，只要房产出售，经纪人都会获得佣金。

segments.src: - **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
segments.tr: - **Buyer representation agreement (买家代理协议)** — 聘请经纪人代表买家的书面合同；自 2024 年 8 月 17 日起，与参与 MLS 的经纪人看房前必须签署。

segments.src: - **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
segments.tr: - **Fiduciary duty (信义义务)** — 经纪人对客户承担的法律义务：忠诚、保密、服从、披露、合理谨慎和资金清算。

segments.src: - **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
segments.tr: - **Dual agency (双重代理)** — 一家经纪公司同时代表买方和卖方；在某些州仅允许在获得书面知情同意的情况下存在，而在其他州则被完全禁止。

segments.src: - **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.
segments.tr: - **E&O insurance (职业疏忽与过失保险)** — 保护经纪人免受专业疏忽或虚假陈述指控索赔的错误与遗漏保险。

segments.tr: *答案：**Q1 — (A)。** “独家专卖权”意味着在合同期内的任何销售都可以赚取佣金；如果卖家希望保留自己找买家免佣金的例外情况，则需要签署独家代理协议或在合同中写入协商好的排除条款。

hi.title: [Real Estate 101 #13] वास्तव में आपके एजेंट को कौन भुगतान करता है — और कानूनी रूप से उनकी आपके प्रति क्या देनदारी है

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > रियल एस्टेट एजेंट का काम तीन दस्तावेजों और एक हस्ताक्षर द्वारा परिभाषित होता है: वह समझौता जो उन्हें काम पर रखता है, वह खंड जो उन्हें भुगतान करता है, और वे खुलासे जो सभी को अदालत जाने से बचाते हैं।

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: अधिकांश लोग रियल एस्टेट एजेंट से उसी तरह मिलते हैं जैसे वे किसी वेटर से मिलते हैं — कोई मित्रवत व्यक्ति आता है, आपको चीजें दिखाता है, और अंत में एक बिल दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: वह मानसिक मॉडल गलत है, और यह राज्य के रियल एस्टेट आयोग के पास दर्ज की जाने वाली लगभग हर शिकायत का स्रोत है।

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: ब्रोकरेज प्रथा तीन स्तंभों पर टिकी है।

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: संबंध बनाने वाला समझौता।**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: कोई एजेंट आपका प्रतिनिधित्व इसलिए नहीं करता क्योंकि वे आपके साथ अच्छे थे।

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: वे आपका प्रतिनिधित्व इसलिए करते हैं क्योंकि आपने किसी दस्तावेज़ पर हस्ताक्षर किए हैं।

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: विक्रेता के पक्ष में यह एक **listing agreement** है; खरीदार के पक्ष में, एक **buyer representation agreement**।

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: अधिकांश राज्यों में लागू करने योग्य होने के लिए इन्हें लिखित रूप में होना चाहिए (*statute of frauds* का एक परिणाम), और उन्हें एक निश्चित समाप्ति तिथि बतानी होगी — कोई अनिश्चितकालीन अनुबंध नहीं।

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: लिस्टिंग विभिन्न प्रकार की होती हैं, और यह अंतर वास्तविक पैसों के लायक है:

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell** — यदि अवधि के दौरान घर बिकता है, तो लिस्टिंग ब्रोकर को भुगतान किया जाता है, *चाहे खरीदार कोई भी ढूंढे*, जिसमें विक्रेता का अपना चचेरा भाई भी शामिल है। यह U.S. में मानक लिस्टिंग है।

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive agency** — ब्रोकर को केवल तभी भुगतान किया जाता है यदि ब्रोकर (या कोई अन्य एजेंट) खरीदार लाता है। यदि विक्रेता स्वयं खरीदार ढूंढता है, तो कोई कमीशन नहीं।

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **Open listing** — विक्रेता कई ब्रोकरों को काम पर रख सकता है; केवल वही जिसे खरीदार मिलता है उसे भुगतान किया जाता है। आवासीय मामलों में दुर्लभ।

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: मुआवजा खंड।**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: कमीशन *नेगोशिएबल (बातचीत के योग्य) है, हमेशा, और कानूनन ऐसा होना आवश्यक है।* कोई भी राज्य, कोई संघ, और कोई MLS मानक दर तय या सुझाव नहीं दे सकता — ऐसा करना संघीय एंटीट्रस्ट कानून के तहत मूल्य निर्धारण (price fixing) है।

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: अंतर केवल इसमें है कि कौन किसे भुगतान करता है, और जब से नेशनल एसोसिएशन ऑफ रियलटर्स का निपटान अभ्यास परिवर्तन **17 अगस्त, 2024** को लागू हुआ, राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर दो चीजें बदल गईं: खरीदार के एजेंटों को मुआवजे की पेशकश अब MLS पर प्रकाशित नहीं की जा सकती है, और एक एजेंट जो MLS भागीदार है, उसके पास खरीदार के साथ घर का दौरा करने से *पहले* एक हस्ताक्षरित लिखित समझौता होना चाहिए।

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: विक्रेता अभी भी खरीदार के एजेंट को कवर करने के लिए सहमत हो सकते हैं — यह लिस्टिंग फीड में विज्ञापित होने के बजाय सौदा करते समय तय किया जाता है।

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: कर्तव्य, और एजेंटों पर मुकदमा दर्ज होने के तरीके।**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: जब कोई एजेंट एजेंट के रूप में आपका प्रतिनिधित्व करता है (न कि एक तटस्थ सुविधाप्रदाता के रूप में), तो उनके ऊपर **fiduciary duties** (न्यासी कर्तव्य) होते हैं: निष्ठा, गोपनीयता, वैध निर्देशों का पालन, सामग्री तथ्यों का प्रकटीकरण, उचित देखभाल, और रखे गए धन का हिसाब-किताब।

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: कमीशन काम का मजेदार हिस्सा हैं; ये कर्तव्य वह हिस्सा हैं जो मुकदमों को जन्म देते हैं।

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: बार-बार होने वाली विफलताएं लगातार उबाऊ होती हैं: किसी ज्ञात भौतिक दोष का खुलासा न करना, बिना लाइसेंस के कानून या मूल्यांकन का अभ्यास करना ("चिंता मत करो, वह सुखाधिकार/easement ठीक है"), बयाना राशि (earnest money) का लापरवाही से संचालन, और **undisclosed dual agency** — बिना लिखित सूचित सहमति के दोनों पक्षों का प्रतिनिधित्व करना।

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: कुछ राज्यों ने यह तय किया है कि यह संघर्ष असहज है और उन्होंने दोहरी एजेंसी (dual agency) पर पूरी तरह से प्रतिबंध लगा दिया है; उदाहरण के लिए, फ्लोरिडा और कोलोराडो इसके बजाय एक तटस्थ **transaction broker** मॉडल का उपयोग करते हैं।

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि ब्रोकरेज **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** रखते हैं और यही कारण है कि फ़ाइल — हर टेक्स्ट, हर प्रकटीकरण, हर हस्ताक्षरित परिशिष्ट — एजेंट का वास्तविक बचाव है।

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: मान लीजिए कि आप Raleigh, North Carolina में **$425,000** में एक टाउनहाउस बेच रहे हैं।

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: आप तय **5% कुल कमीशन** पर 6 महीने के exclusive right to sell लिस्टिंग अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर करते हैं, जिसमें आपका लिस्टिंग समझौता आपको खरीदार के एजेंट शामिल होने पर खरीदार के एजेंट को **2.5%** की पेशकश करने के लिए अधिकृत करता है।

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: समापन (closing) पर:

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: वह $10,625 आपके एजेंट के पास नहीं जाता है।

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: यह **broker** के पास जाता है, जो इसे अपने आंतरिक समझौते के तहत एजेंट के साथ साझा करता है — एक 50/50 नए एजेंट का बंटवारा फ्रैंचाइज़ी शुल्क, MLS शुल्क, विपणन लागत और स्व-रोजगार कर से पहले $5,312.50 छोड़ता है।

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: इसे समझना आपके बातचीत करने के तरीके को बदल देता है: आप एक ऐसे व्यवसाय के साथ बातचीत कर रहे हैं जिसकी एक लागत सीमा (cost floor) है, न कि किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के साथ जो जेब में $21,250 डाल रहा है।

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: अब वे हिस्से जो वास्तव में नुकसान पहुंचाते हैं।

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **महीना 4:** आपका पड़ोसी सीधे खरीदने की पेशकश करता है।

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: *exclusive right to sell* के तहत, आपका ब्रोकर अभी भी कमीशन का हकदार है।

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: *exclusive agency* लिस्टिंग के तहत, वे हकदार नहीं हैं।

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: एक अनुबंध में एक शब्द जिसे आपने ध्यान से नहीं पढ़ा, उसमें $21,250 का अंतर था।

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **महीना 5:** आपका एजेंट एक ऐसा खरीदार लाता है जिसका वे खुद भी प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: North Carolina में यह केवल दोनों पक्षों की पूर्व लिखित सहमति के साथ कानूनी है, और एजेंट को मूल्य और शर्तों पर किसी भी पक्ष को सलाह देना बंद कर देना चाहिए।

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: यदि उन्होंने कभी नहीं पूछा — तो वह लाइसेंस संबंधी शिकायत है।

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **समापन का दिन (Closing day):** आपको एक ईमेल मिलता है जो बिल्कुल आपके क्लोजिंग वकील के ईमेल जैसा दिखता है, जिसमें अपडेट किए गए वायर निर्देश और "कृपया जल्दी करें" नोट है।

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: आधुनिक आवासीय रियल एस्टेट में यह सबसे महंगी गलती है।

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: FBI का इंटरनेट क्राइम कम्प्लेन्ट सेंटर एक वर्ष में हजारों रियल एस्टेट वायर धोखाधड़ी की शिकायतों को दर्ज करता है, जिसमें सैकड़ों मिलियन डॉलर का नुकसान होता है, और स्थानांतरित धन अक्सर कुछ घंटों के भीतर अप्राप्य हो जाता है।

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **ईमेल द्वारा कभी भी वायर निर्देश स्वीकार न करें।** क्लोजिंग ऑफिस को उस नंबर पर कॉल करें जिसे आपने स्वयं खोजा है — ईमेल में छपे नंबर पर नहीं — और हर एक अंक को सत्यापित करें।

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. एक एजेंसी संबंध — और आपके हितों की रक्षा करने का कर्तव्य — एक हस्ताक्षरित लिस्टिंग या खरीदार प्रतिनिधित्व समझौते से शुरू होता है, न कि केवल हाथ मिलाने से।

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. कमीशन कानून द्वारा बातचीत के योग्य है, *broker* को भुगतान किया जाता है और वहां से विभाजित होता है; अगस्त 2024 से यह MLS पर विज्ञापित होने के बजाय लेनदेन के भीतर तय किया जाता है।

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. अधिकांश ब्रोकरेज आपदाएं कागजी कार्रवाई की रोके जाने योग्य समस्याएं हैं: अघोषित दोहरी एजेंसी (dual agency), अलिखित भौतिक दोष, और फोन द्वारा सत्यापित वायर निर्देश।

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
segments.tr: - **Listing agreement** — वह लिखित अनुबंध जिसमें एक विक्रेता संपत्ति के विपणन के लिए एक ब्रोकर को काम पर रखता है, अवधि, मूल्य और मुआवजा तय करता है।

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell** — लिस्टिंग का वह प्रकार जहां अवधि के दौरान किसी भी बिक्री पर ब्रोकर को भुगतान किया जाता है, भले ही खरीदार किसने ढूंढा हो।

segments.src: - **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
segments.tr: - **Buyer representation agreement** — किसी खरीदार का प्रतिनिधित्व करने के लिए एक ब्रोकर को काम पर रखने वाला लिखित अनुबंध; 17 अगस्त, 2024 तक MLS-भागीदार एजेंट के साथ घरों का दौरा करने से पहले आवश्यक है।

segments.src: - **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
segments.tr: - **Fiduciary duty** — ग्राहक के प्रति एजेंट के कानूनी दायित्व: वफादारी, गोपनीयता, आज्ञाकारिता, प्रकटीकरण, उचित देखभाल और लेखांकन।

segments.src: - **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
segments.tr: - **Dual agency** — एक ही ब्रोकरेज जो खरीदार और विक्रेता दोनों का प्रतिनिधित्व करती है; कुछ राज्यों में केवल लिखित सूचित सहमति से अनुमति दी जाती है, और अन्य में प्रतिबंधित है।

segments.src: - **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.
segments.tr: - **E&O insurance** — त्रुटियों और चूक (Errors and omissions) की कवरेज जो ब्रोकरों को पेशेवर लापरवाही या गलत बयानी के दावों से बचाती है।

es.title: [Bienes Raíces 101 #13] Quién le paga realmente a su agente — y qué le debe legalmente

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > El trabajo de un agente inmobiliario está definido por tres documentos y una firma: el acuerdo que lo contrata, la cláusula que le paga y las divulgaciones que mantienen a todos fuera de los tribunales.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: La mayoría de las personas conocen a un agente inmobiliario de la misma manera que conocen a un camarero: alguien amable aparece, le muestra cosas y al final aparece una cuenta.

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: Ese modelo mental es erróneo y es la fuente de casi todas las quejas presentadas ante una comisión estatal de bienes raíces.

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: La práctica de corretaje se apoya en tres pilares.

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: El acuerdo que crea la relación.**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: Un agente no lo representa a usted porque fue amable con usted.

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: Lo representa porque usted firmó algo.

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: Del lado del vendedor, eso es un **acuerdo de comercialización (listing agreement)**; del lado del comprador, un **acuerdo de representación del comprador (buyer representation agreement)**.

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: En la mayoría de los estados, estos deben ser por escrito para ser exigibles (una consecuencia de la *ley de fraudes* o *statute of frauds*), y deben establecer una fecha de vencimiento definitiva; nada de contratos indefinidos.

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: Los contratos de comercialización vienen en varios tipos, y la diferencia vale dinero real:

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **Derecho exclusivo de venta (Exclusive right to sell)** — el corredor de comercialización cobra si la casa se vende durante el plazo, *sin importar quién encuentre al comprador*, incluso si es el propio primo del vendedor. Este es el contrato estándar en EE. UU.

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **Agencia exclusiva (Exclusive agency)** — al corredor se le paga solo si el corredor (u otro agente) consigue al comprador. Si el vendedor encuentra al comprador por sí mismo, no hay comisión.

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **Contrato abierto (Open listing)** — el vendedor puede contratar a múltiples corredores; solo cobra el que consigue al comprador. Es raro en bienes raíces residenciales.

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: La cláusula de compensación.**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: La comisión es *negociable, siempre, y por ley debe serlo.* Ningún estado, ninguna asociación y ningún MLS puede fijar o sugerir una tarifa estándar; hacerlo es fijación de precios bajo la ley federal de defensa de la competencia (antitrust).

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: Lo que varía es quién paga a quién, y desde que los cambios en las prácticas tras el acuerdo de la Asociación Nacional de Realtors entraron en vigor el **17 de agosto de 2024**, dos cosas cambiaron a nivel nacional: las ofertas de compensación a los agentes de compradores ya no se pueden publicar en un MLS, y un agente que sea participante del MLS debe tener un acuerdo por escrito firmado con el comprador *antes* de recorrer una casa con él.

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: Los vendedores aún pueden aceptar cubrir al agente del comprador; simplemente se negocia en la transacción en lugar de anunciarse en el feed del MLS.

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: Los deberes y las formas en que los agentes son demandados.**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: Cuando un agente lo representa como agente (en lugar de como un facilitador neutral), le debe **deberes fiduciarios**: lealtad, confidencialidad, obediencia a instrucciones legales, divulgación de hechos relevantes, cuidado razonable y rinde de cuentas del dinero retenido.

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: Las comisiones son la parte divertida del trabajo; estos deberes son la parte que genera demandas.

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: Las fallas recurrentes son aburridamente consistentes: no divulgar un defecto material conocido, ejercer el derecho o la tasación sin licencia ("no te preocupes, esa servidumbre está bien"), manejo descuidado del dinero de arras (earnest money) y la **doble agencia no divulgada** — representar a ambas partes sin un consentimiento informado por escrito.

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: Algunos estados han decidido que el conflicto es inmanejable y han prohibido la doble agencia por completo; Florida y Colorado, por ejemplo, utilizan en su lugar un modelo neutral de **corredor de transacción (transaction broker)**.

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: Por esta razón, las corredurías contratan **seguros de errores u omisiones (E&O)** y por eso el expediente —cada mensaje de texto, cada divulgación, cada anexo firmado— es la verdadera defensa del agente.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## En la vida real

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: Supongamos que está vendiendo una casa adosada en Raleigh, Carolina del Norte, por **$425,000**.

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: Firma un contrato de comercialización con derecho exclusivo de venta de 6 meses con una **comisión total negociada del 5%**, autorizando en su acuerdo de comercialización el ofrecer un **2.5%** al agente del comprador si interviene uno.

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: En el cierre:

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: Esos $10,625 no van a su agente.

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: Van al **corredor (broker)**, quien los divide con el agente según su acuerdo interno: una división 50/50 para un agente nuevo deja $5,312.50 antes de las tarifas de franquicia, cuotas de MLS, costos de marketing e impuestos sobre el trabajo por cuenta propia.

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: Comprender esto cambia la forma en que negocia: está negociando con un negocio que tiene un costo mínimo, no con una persona que se embolsa $21,250.

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: Ahora, las partes que realmente duelen.

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **Mes 4:** su vecino se ofrece a comprar directamente.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: Bajo un *derecho exclusivo de venta*, a su corredor todavía se le debe la comisión.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: Bajo un contrato de *agencia exclusiva*, no.

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: Una palabra en un contrato que leyó por encima, $21,250 de diferencia.

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **Mes 5:** su agente trae a un comprador al que también representa.

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: En Carolina del Norte, eso es legal solo con el consentimiento previo por escrito de ambas partes, y el agente debe dejar de asesorar a ambas partes sobre el precio y los términos.

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: Si nunca lo pidió, eso es motivo de queja sobre la licencia.

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **Día del cierre:** recibe un correo electrónico que se ve exactamente como el de su abogado de cierre, con instrucciones de transferencia bancaria actualizadas y una nota de "por favor apúrese".

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: Este es el error individual más costoso en el sector inmobiliario residencial moderno.

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: El Centro de Quejas de Delitos en Internet del FBI registra miles de quejas por fraude en transferencias bancarias inmobiliarias al año, con pérdidas de cientos de millones de dólares, y los fondos transferidos suelen ser irrecuperables en cuestión de horas.

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **Nunca acepte instrucciones de transferencia por correo electrónico.** Llame a la oficina de cierre a un número que haya buscado usted mismo —no a uno impreso en el correo electrónico— y verifique cada dígito.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Resumen de 3 líneas

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. Una relación de agencia —y el deber de proteger sus intereses— comienza con un contrato firmado de comercialización o de representación del comprador, no con un apretón de manos.

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. La comisión es negociable por ley, se paga al *corredor* y se divide a partir de ahí; desde agosto de 2024 se negocia dentro de la transacción en lugar de anunciarse en el MLS.

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. La mayoría de los desastres en el corretaje son problemas de papeleo evitables: doble agencia no divulgada, defectos materiales no escritos e instrucciones de transferencia no verificadas por teléfono.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Cuestionario

segments.src: **Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing.
segments.tr: **P1.** Firma un contrato de **derecho exclusivo de venta** de 6 meses.

segments.src: In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own.
segments.tr: En el mes 3 encuentra un comprador totalmente por su cuenta.

segments.src: Does the listing broker earn a commission?

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Glosario de hoy

segments.src: - **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
segments.tr: - **Listing agreement (Acuerdo de comercialización)** — El contrato por escrito en el que un vendedor contrata a un corredor para comercializar la propiedad, estableciendo el plazo, el precio y la compensación.

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell (Derecho exclusivo de venta)** — El tipo de contrato en el que al corredor se le paga por cualquier venta durante el plazo, independientemente de quién haya encontrado al comprador.

segments.src: - **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
segments.tr: - **Buyer representation agreement (Acuerdo de representación del comprador)** — El contrato por escrito que contrata a un corredor para representar a un comprador; requerido antes de visitar casas con un agente participante del MLS a partir del 17 de agosto de 2024.

segments.src: - **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
segments.tr: - **Fiduciary duty (Deber fiduciario)** — Las obligaciones legales del agente hacia un cliente: lealtad, confidencialidad, obediencia, divulgación, cuidado razonable y rendición de cuentas.

segments.src: - **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
segments.tr: - **Dual agency (Doble agencia)** — Una misma correduría que representa tanto al comprador como al vendedor; permitida solo con consentimiento informado por escrito en algunos estados, y prohibida en otros.

segments.src: - **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.
segments.tr: - **E&O insurance (Seguro de E&O)** — Cobertura de errores u omisiones que protege a los corredores contra reclamaciones por negligencia profesional o tergiversación.

ar.title: [أساسيات العقارات #13] من يدفع بالفعل لوكيلك العقاري — وما ينبغي عليه قانونًا تجاهك

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > يتحدد عمل الوكيل العقاري بثلاث وثائق وتوقيع واحد: الاتفاقية التي توظفه، والبند الذي يدفع له، والإفصاحات التي تبعد الجميع عن المحاكم.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## مفهوم اليوم

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: يلتقي معظم الناس بالوكيل العقاري بالطريقة نفسها التي يلتقون بها بالنادل — يظهر شخص ودود، ويعرض عليك الأشياء، ثم تظهر الفاتورة في النهاية.

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: هذا النموذج الذهني خاطئ، وهو المصدر لنصف الشكاوى المقدمة تقريبًا إلى هيئات العقارات في الولايات.

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: تستند ممارسة الوساطة العقارية إلى ثلاثة أركان.

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: الاتفاقية التي تنشئ العلاقة.**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: الوكيل لا يمثلك لمجرد أنه كان لطيفًا معك.

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: بل يمثلك لأنك وقعت على شيء ما.

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: على جانب البائع، تسمى **اتفاقية الإدراج (listing agreement)**؛ وعلى جانب المشتري، **اتفاقية تمثيل المشتري (buyer representation agreement)**.

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: في معظم الولايات، يجب أن تكون هذه الاتفاقيات مكتوبة لتكون قابلة للتنفيذ (نتيجة لـ *قانون الاحتيال/statute of frauds*)، ويجب أن تحدد تاريخ انتهاء واضحًا — لا عقود مفتوحة.

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: تأتي قائمة الإدراج بأنواع مختلفة، والفرق بينها يستحق أموالاً حقيقية:

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **الحق الحصري للبيع (Exclusive right to sell)** — يتم الدفع للوسيط المدرِج إذا تم بيع المنزل خلال المدة، *بغض النظر عمن وجد المشتري*، حتى لو كان ابن عم البائع نفسه. هذا هو الإدراج القياسي في الولايات المتحدة.

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **الوكالة الحصرية (Exclusive agency)** — يتم الدفع للوسيط فقط إذا قام الوسيط (أو وكيل آخر) بجلبه. إذا وجد البائع المشتري بنفسه، فلا توجد عمولة.

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **الإدراج المفتوح (Open listing)** — يمكن للبائع توظيف العديد من الوسطاء؛ فقط الشخص الذي يجلب المشتري يحصل على المال. نادر في العقارات السكنية.

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: بند التعويض (العمولة).**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: العمولة *قابلة للتفاوض دائمًا، ويجب أن تكون كذلك بموجب القانون.* لا يجوز لأي ولاية أو جمعية أو خدمة إدراج متعددة (MLS) تحديد أو اقتراح سعر قياسي — ففعل ذلك يعد تثبيتًا للأسعار بموجب قانون مكافحة الاحتكار الفيدرالي.

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: ما يختلف هو من يدفع لمن، ومنذ دخلت تغييرات ممارسة التسوية الخاصة بالجمعية الوطنية للوسطاء العقاريين حيز التنفيذ في **17 أغسطس 2024**، تغير أمرين على الصعيد الوطني: لم يعد من الممكن نشر عروض التعويض لوكلاء المشتري على MLS، ويجب على الوكيل المشارك في MLS الحصول على اتفاقية كتابية موقعة مع المشتري *قبل* القيام بجولة في منزل معه.

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: ما يزال بإمكان البائعين الموافقة على تغطية وكيل المشتري — يتم التفاوض على ذلك الآن في الصفقة بدلاً من الإعلان عنه في موجز الإدراج.

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: الواجبات، والطرق التي يتم بها مقاضاة الوكلاء.**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: عندما يمثلك الوكيل كوكيل (بدلاً من ميسر محايد)، فإنه يدين لك بـ **واجبات ائتمانية**: الولاء، السرية، الطاعة للتعليمات القانونية، الإفصاح عن الحقائق الجوهرية، العناية المعقولة، والمحاسبة عن الأموال المحتفظ بها.

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: العمولات هي الجزء الممتع من الوظيفة؛ وهذه الواجبات هي الجزء الذي يولد الدعاوى القضائية.

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: أنماط الفشل المتكررة متسقة ومملة: عدم الإفصاح عن عيب جوهري معروف، ممارسة القانون أو التقييم بدون ترخيص ("لا تقلق، هذا الارتفاق لا بأس به")، التعامل الإهمالي مع العربون، و**الوكالة المزدوجة غير المفقصح عنها** — تمثيل كلا الطرفين دون موافقة كتابية مستنيرة.

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: قررت بعض الولايات أن التضارب لا يمكن إدارته وحظرت الوكالة المزدوجة تمامًا؛ فلوريدا وكولورادو، على سبيل المثال، تستخدمان نموذج **وسيط المعاملات (transaction broker)** المحايد بدلاً من ذلك.

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: هذا هو السبب في أن شركات الوساطة تحمل **تأمين الأخطاء والسهو (E&O)** ولماذا يكون الملف — كل رسالة نصية، كل إفصاح، كل ملحق موقع — هو الدفاع الحقيقي للوكيل.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: لنفترض أنك تبيع منزلًا متصلًا (townhouse) في رالي، كارولاينا الشمالية مقابل **$425,000**.

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: توقع على إدراج بالحق الحصري للبيع لمدة 6 أشهر بعمولة **إجمالية تفاوضية قدرها 5%**، مع تفويض اتفاقية الإدراج الخاصة بك بتقديم **2.5%** لوكيل المشتري إذا كان هناك وكيل للمشتري.

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: عند الإغلاق:

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: مبلغ $10,625 هذا لا يذهب إلى وكيلك.

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: بل يذهب إلى **الوسيط**، الذي يتقاسمه مع الوكيل بموجب اتفاقهما الداخلي — تقسيم 50/50 للوكيل الجديد يترك $5,312.50 قبل رسوم الابتكار (franchise)، ودوريات MLS، وتكاليف التسويق، وضريبة العمل الحر.

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: فهم هذا يغير طريقة تفاوضك: أنت تتفاوض مع شركة لديها حد أدنى للتكاليف، وليس مع شخص يضع $21,250 في جيبه.

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: الآن إلى الأجزاء التي تؤثر حقًا.

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **الشهر 4:** يعرض جارك الشراء مباشرة.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: بموجب *الحق الحصري للبيع*، ما يزال وسيطك يستحق العمولة.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: بموجب إدراج *الوكالة الحصرية*، لا يستحقونها.

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: كلمة واحدة في عقد قرأته بسرعة تجعل الفرق $21,250.

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **الشهر 5:** يجلب وكيلك مشتريًا يمثله هو أيضًا.

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: في كارولاينا الشمالية، يكون هذا قانونيًا فقط بموافقة كتابية مسبقة من كلا الطرفين، ويجب على الوكيل التوقف عن نصح أي من الطرفين بشأن السعر والشروط.

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: إذا لم يطلبوا ذلك مطلقًا — فهذه شكوى ترخيص.

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **يوم الإغلاق:** تتلقى بريدًا إلكترونيًا يبدو تمامًا مثل بريد محامي الإغلاق الخاص بك، مع تعليمات تحويل تحويل بكيبل جديدة وملاحظة "يرجى الإسراع".

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: هذا هو الخطأ الأكثر تكلفة على الإطلاق في العقارات السكنية الحديثة.

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: يسجل مركز شكاوى جرائم الإنترنت التابع لـ FBI آلاف الشكاوى من الاحتيال في التحويلات المالية العقارية سنوياً، بخسائر تصل إلى مئات الملايين من الدولارات، وغالباً ما تكون الأموال المحولة غير قابلة للاسترداد خلال ساعات.

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **لا تقبل أبدًا تعليمات التحويل عبر البريد الإلكتروني.** اتصل بمكتب الإغلاق على رقم بحثت عنه بنفسك — ليس رقمًا مطبوعًا في البريد الإلكتروني — وتحقق من كل رقم.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## ملخص في 3 أسطر

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. تبدأ علاقة الوكالة — والواجب في حماية مصالحك — باتفاقية إدراج موقعة أو اتفاقية تمثيل المشتري، وليس بمصافحة.

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. العمولة قابلة للتفاوض بموجب القانون، وتدفَع لـ *الوسيط* وتُقسم من هناك؛ منذ أغسطس 2024 يتم التفاوض عليها داخل المعاملة بدلاً من الإعلان عنها على MLS.

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. معظم كوارث الوساطة العقارية هي مشاكل أوراق يمكن الوقاية منها: وكالة مزدوجة غير مفصح عنها، عيوب جوهرية غير مكتوبة، وتعليمات تحويل بنكي يتم التحقق منها عبر الهاتف.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: **Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing.
segments.tr: **س1.** وقعت على إدراج **بأن له الحق الحصري للبيع** لمدة 6 أشهر.

segments.src: In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own.
segments.tr: في الشهر 3 تجد مشتريًا بمفردك تمامًا.

segments.src: Does the listing broker earn a commission?
segments.tr: هل يستحق الوسيط المدرِج عمولة؟

segments.src: - (A) Yes, the full negotiated commission
segments.tr: - (أ) نعم، العمولة التفاوضية الكاملة

segments.src: - (B) No, because the broker didn't produce the buyer
segments.tr: - (ب) لا، لأن الوسيط لم يجلب المشتري

segments.src: - (C) Only half, automatically
segments.tr: - (ج) النصف فقط تلقائيًا

segments.src: (O/X)** Since the August 2024 practice changes, U.S.
segments.tr: (صواب/خطأ)** منذ تغييرات الممارسة في أغسطس 2024، تتبع العمولات

segments.src: real estate commissions follow a standard national rate set by the industry.
segments.tr: العقارية في الولايات المتحدة معدلاً قياسياً وطنياً تحدده الصناعة.

segments.src: **Q3.** Two days before closing you receive an email from your title company with new wire instructions.
segments.tr: **س3.** قبل يومين من الإغلاق، تتلقى بريدًا إلكترونيًا من شركة الملكية يحتوي على تعليمات تحويل بنكي جديدة.

segments.src: What's the correct move?
segments.tr: ما هي الخطوة الصحيحة؟

segments.src: - (A) Reply to the email asking them to confirm
segments.tr: - (أ) الرد على البريد الإلكتروني وطلب التأكيد منهم

segments.src: - (B) Call the title company at a number you independently verified and confirm the instructions
