fr.title: [Immobilier 101 #13] Qui paie réellement votre agent — et ce qu'il vous doit légalement

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > Le travail d'un agent immobilier est défini par trois documents et une signature : le contrat qui l'embauche, la clause qui le rémunère et les divulgations qui évitent à tout le monde d'aller au tribunal.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: La plupart des gens rencontrent un agent immobilier comme ils rencontrent un serveur — quelqu'un d'aimable arrive, vous montre des choses, et une facture apparaît à la fin.

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: Ce modèle mental est faux, et c'est la source de presque toutes les plaintes déposées auprès de la commission de l'immobilier d'un État.

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: La pratique du courtage repose sur trois piliers.

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: Le contrat qui crée la relation.**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: Un agent ne vous représente pas parce qu'il a été gentil avec vous.

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: Il vous représente parce que vous avez signé quelque chose.

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: Du côté du vendeur, il s'agit d'un **mandat de vente** (listing agreement) ; du côté de l'acheteur, d'un **mandat de recherche** (buyer representation agreement).

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: Dans la plupart des États, ceux-ci doivent être rédigés par écrit pour être exécutoires (une conséquence de la *loi sur les fraudes / statute of frauds*), et ils doivent indiquer une date d'expiration précise — pas de contrats à durée indéterminée.

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: Les mandats existent en plusieurs catégories, et la différence vaut de l'argent réel :

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **Mandat exclusif (Exclusive right to sell)** — le courtier inscripteur est payé si la maison est vendue pendant la durée du mandat, *peu importe qui trouve l'acheteur*, y compris le propre cousin du vendeur. C'est le mandat standard aux États-Unis.

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **Mandat semi-exclusif (Exclusive agency)** — le courtier n'est payé que si le courtier (ou un autre agent) apporte l'acheteur. Si le vendeur trouve l'acheteur lui-même, pas de commission.

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **Mandat simple (Open listing)** — le vendeur peut engager plusieurs courtiers ; seul celui qui apporte l'acheteur est payé. Rare dans le résidentiel.

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: La clause de rémunération.**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: La commission est *négociable, toujours, et de par la loi, elle doit l'être.* Aucun État, aucune association, ni aucun MLS ne peut fixer ou suggérer un taux standard — le faire constitue une entente sur les prix au regard du droit fédéral de la concurrence.

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: Ce qui varie, c'est qui paie qui, et depuis que les changements de pratique issus du règlement de la National Association of Realtors sont entrés en vigueur le **17 août 2024**, deux choses ont changé au niveau national : les offres de rémunération aux agents de l'acheteur ne peuvent plus être publiées sur un MLS, et un agent participant au MLS doit avoir un accord écrit signé avec un acheteur *avant* de visiter une maison avec lui.

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: Les vendeurs peuvent toujours accepter de couvrir l'agent de l'acheteur — c'est simplement négocié dans la transaction désormais, plutôt qu'affiché dans le flux d'annonces du MLS.

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: Les devoirs, et la manière dont les agents se font poursuivre.**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un agent vous représente en tant qu'agent (plutôt qu'en tant qu'intermédiaire neutre), il vous doit des **devoirs fiduciaires** (fiduciary duties) : loyauté, confidentialité, obéissance aux instructions légales, divulgation des faits importants, diligence raisonnable et reddition des comptes pour l'argent détenu.

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: Les commissions sont la partie amusante du travail ; ces devoirs sont la partie qui génère des procès.

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: Les modes de défaillance récurrents sont d'une consistance ennuyeuse : ne pas divulguer un vice matériel connu, exercer le droit ou l'évaluation immobilière sans licence (« ne vous inquiétez pas, cette servitude ne pose pas de problème »), gestion négligente du dépôt de garantie (earnest money), et **double agence non divulguée** — représenter les deux parties sans leur consentement éclairé écrit.

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: Certains États ont décidé que le conflit était ingérable et ont purement et simplement interdit la double agence ; la Floride et le Colorado, par exemple, utilisent à la place un modèle neutre de **courtier de transaction** (transaction broker).

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les agences souscrivent une **assurance erreurs et omissions (E&O)** et pourquoi le dossier — chaque SMS, chaque divulgation, chaque avenant signé — est la véritable défense de l'agent.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Au quotidien

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: Imaginons que vous vendiez une maison de ville à Raleigh, en Caroline du Nord, pour **$425,000**.

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: Vous signez un mandat exclusif de 6 mois avec une **commission totale négociée de 5%**, votre mandat de vente vous autorisant à offrir **2.5%** à l'agent d'un acheteur si un agent d'acheteur est impliqué.

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: À la clôture de la vente :

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: Ces $10,625 ne vont pas à votre agent.

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: Ils vont au **courtier** (broker), qui les partage avec l'agent selon leur contrat interne — un partage 50/50 pour un nouvel agent laisse $5,312.50 avant les frais de franchise, les cotisations MLS, les coûts de marketing et la taxe sur le travail indépendant.

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: Comprendre cela change votre façon de négocier : vous négociez avec une entreprise qui a un plancher de coûts, pas avec une personne qui met $21,250 dans sa poche.

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: Maintenant, les parties qui font vraiment mal.

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **Mois 4 :** votre voisin propose d'acheter directement.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: Sous un *mandat exclusif*, la commission est toujours due à votre courtier.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: Sous un *mandat semi-exclusif*, elle ne l'est pas.

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: Un mot dans un contrat que vous avez parcouru rapidement, une différence de $21,250.

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **Mois 5 :** votre agent amène un acheteur qu'il représente également.

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: En Caroline du Nord, cela n'est légal qu'avec le consentement écrit préalable des deux parties, et l'agent doit cesser de conseiller l'une ou l'autre partie sur le prix et les conditions.

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: S'il n'a jamais demandé — c'est une plainte auprès de l'organisme de délivrance des licences.

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **Jour de la clôture :** vous recevez un e-mail qui ressemble exactement à celui de votre avocat chargé de la clôture, avec des instructions de virement mises à jour et une note « s'il vous plaît, faites vite ».

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: C'est l'erreur la plus coûteuse de l'immobilier résidentiel moderne.

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: L'Internet Crime Complaint Center du FBI enregistre des milliers de plaintes pour fraude au virement immobilier par an, avec des pertes se comptant en centaines de millions de dollars, et les fonds virés sont souvent irrécupérables en quelques heures.

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **N'acceptez jamais d'instructions de virement par e-mail.** Appelez le bureau chargé de la clôture à un numéro que vous avez recherché vous-même — pas un numéro imprimé dans l'e-mail — et vérifiez chaque chiffre.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 points

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. Une relation de représentation (agency) — et l'obligation de protéger vos intérêts — commence par un mandat de vente ou de recherche signé, pas par une poignée de main.

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. La commission est négociable par la loi, payée au *courtier* puis partagée à partir de là ; depuis août 2024, elle est négociée au sein de la transaction plutôt qu'affichée sur le MLS.

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. La plupart des catastrophes en courtage sont des problèmes administratifs évitables : double agence non divulguée, vices matériels non écrits et instructions de virement non vérifiées par téléphone.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-évaluation

segments.src: **Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing.
segments.tr: **Q1.** Vous signez un mandat **exclusif** (exclusive right to sell) de 6 mois.

segments.src: In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own.
segments.tr: Au mois 3, vous trouvez un acheteur entièrement par vous-même.

segments.src: Does the listing broker earn a commission?
segments.tr: Le courtier inscripteur perçoit-il une commission ?

segments.src: - (A) Yes, the full negotiated commission
segments.tr: - (A) Oui, la commission négociée intégrale

segments.src: - (B) No, because the broker didn't produce the buyer
segments.tr: - (B) Non, parce que le courtier n'a pas trouvé l'acheteur

segments.src: - (C) Only half, automatically
segments.tr: - (C) Seulement la moitié, automatiquement

segments.src: (O/X)** Since the August 2024 practice changes, U.S.
segments.tr: (V/F)** Depuis les changements de pratique d'août 2024, les commissions immobilières aux États-Unis

segments.src: real estate commissions follow a standard national rate set by the industry.
segments.tr: suivent un taux national standard fixé par le secteur.

segments.src: **Q3.** Two days before closing you receive an email from your title company with new wire instructions.
segments.tr: **Q3.** Deux jours avant la clôture, vous recevez un e-mail de votre société de titre avec de nouvelles instructions de virement.

segments.src: What's the correct move?
segments.tr: Quelle est la bonne démarche ?

segments.src: - (A) Reply to the email asking them to confirm
segments.tr: - (A) Répondre à l'e-mail pour leur demander de confirmer

segments.src: - (B) Call the title company at a number you independently verified and confirm the instructions
segments.tr: - (B) Appeler la société de titre à un numéro que vous avez vérifié de manière indépendante et confirmer les instructions

segments.src: - (C) Wire a small test amount first, then the rest
segments.tr: - (C) Envoyer d'abord un petit montant de test, puis le reste

pt.title: [Real Estate 101 #13] Quem realmente paga o seu corretor — e o que eles legalmente lhe devem

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > O trabalho de um corretor de imóveis é definido por três documentos e uma assinatura: o contrato que o contrata, a cláusula que o paga e as declarações que mantêm todos fora do tribunal.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: A maioria das pessoas conhece um corretor de imóveis da mesma forma que conhece um garçom — alguém amigável aparece, mostra as coisas e uma conta surge no final.

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: Esse modelo mental está errado, e é a origem de quase todas as reclamações registradas em comissões estaduais de corretagem imobiliária.

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: A prática de corretagem apoia-se em três pilares.

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: O contrato que cria a relação.**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: Um corretor não representa você porque foi legal com você.

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: Ele representa você porque você assinou algo.

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: Do lado do vendedor, trata-se de um **listing agreement** (contrato de corretagem); do lado do comprador, um **buyer representation agreement** (contrato de representação do comprador).

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: Na maioria dos estados americanos, estes contratos devem ser por escrito para serem exigíveis (uma consequência do *statute of frauds*), e devem estipular uma data de validade definida — nada de contratos por prazo indeterminado.

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: Os contratos de venda vêm em diferentes modalidades, e a diferença vale dinheiro real:

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell** (direito exclusivo de venda) — o corretor contratado é pago se o imóvel for vendido durante o prazo do contrato, *não importa quem encontre o comprador*, inclusive se for o próprio primo do vendedor. Este é o contrato padrão nos EUA.

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive agency** (agenciamento exclusivo) — o corretor é pago apenas se ele (ou outro corretor) trouxer o comprador. Se o próprio vendedor encontrar o comprador sozinho, não há comissão.

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **Open listing** (contrato aberto) — o vendedor pode contratar vários corretores; apenas aquele que trouxer o comprador é pago. Raro no mercado residencial.

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: A cláusula de remuneração.**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: A comissão é *negociável, sempre, e por lei tem de ser.* Nenhum estado, nenhuma associação e nenhum MLS pode definir ou sugerir uma taxa padrão — fazer isso é fixação de preços sob a lei antitruste federal.

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: O que varia é quem paga a quem, e desde que as mudanças nas práticas de acordo da National Association of Realtors entraram em vigor em **August 17, 2024**, duas coisas mudaram nacionalmente: ofertas de remuneração para corretores de compradores não podem mais ser publicadas em um MLS, e um corretor que seja participante do MLS deve ter um contrato assinado por escrito com o comprador *antes* de visitar um imóvel com ele.

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: Os vendedores ainda podem concordar em cobrir a comissão do corretor do comprador — isso apenas é negociado na transação agora, em vez de ser anunciado no feed do MLS.

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: Os deveres e as formas como os corretores são processados.**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: Quando um corretor representa você como agente (em vez de um facilitador neutro), ele lhe deve **deveres fiduciários**: lealdade, confidencialidade, obediência a instruções legais, divulgação de fatos relevantes, cuidado razoável e prestação de contas do dinheiro retido.

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: As comissões são a parte divertida do trabalho; esses deveres são a parte que gera processos judiciais.

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: Os padrões recorrentes de falha são incrivelmente consistentes: não divulgar um defeito material conhecido, exercer advocacia ou avaliação de imóveis sem licença ("não se preocupe, essa servidão de passagem está ok"), manuseio desleixado do sinal de reserva (earnest money) e **dupla representação não divulgada (undisclosed dual agency)** — representar ambas as partes sem o consentimento prévio por escrito e informado.

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: Alguns estados decidiram que o conflito é impossível de gerenciar e proibiram totalmente a dupla representação; a Flórida e o Colorado, por exemplo, utilizam em seu lugar um modelo neutro de **transaction broker** (corretor de transação).

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: É por isso que as imobiliárias contratam **seguro de erros e omissões (E&O)** e por que o arquivo — cada mensagem de texto, cada declaração, cada aditivo assinado — é a verdadeira defesa do corretor.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: Digamos que você esteja vendendo uma casa geminada em Raleigh, Carolina do Norte, por **$425,000**.

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: Você assina um contrato de direito exclusivo de venda de 6 meses com uma **comissão total negociada de 5%**, com o seu contrato de corretagem autorizando você a oferecer **2.5%** ao corretor do comprador, caso haja um envolvido.

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: No fechamento:

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: Esses $10,625 não vão diretamente para o seu corretor.

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: Eles vão para a **imobiliária (broker)**, que os divide com o corretor conforme o acordo interno deles — uma divisão de 50/50 para um corretor novo deixa $5,312.50 antes das taxas de franquia, mensalidades do MLS, custos de marketing e impostos de trabalho autônomo.

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: Entender isso muda a forma como você negocia: você está negociando com uma empresa que possui um piso de custos, não com uma pessoa embolsando $21,250.

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: Agora, as partes que realmente doem.

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **Mês 4:** seu vizinho se oferece para comprar diretamente de você.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: Sob um contrato de *exclusive right to sell*, a comissão ainda é devida à sua imobiliária.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: Sob um contrato de *exclusive agency*, ela não é devida.

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: Uma única palavra em um contrato que você leu superficialmente, $21,250 de diferença.

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **Mês 5:** seu corretor traz um comprador que ele também representa.

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: Na Carolina do Norte, isso é legal apenas com o consentimento prévio por escrito de ambas as partes, e o corretor deve parar de aconselhar qualquer um dos lados sobre preço e termos.

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: Se ele nunca perguntou — isso é motivo de reclamação contra a licença dele.

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **Dia do fechamento:** você recebe um e-mail idêntico ao do seu advogado de fechamento, com instruções de transferência bancária atualizadas e uma nota de "por favor, pressa".

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: Este é o erro individual mais caro no mercado imobiliário residencial moderno.

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: O Centro de Denúncias de Crimes na Internet do FBI registra milhares de queixas de fraude em transferências imobiliárias por ano, com prejuízos na casa das centenas de milhões de dólares, e os fundos transferidos costumam ser irrecuperáveis em poucas horas.

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **Nunca aceite instruções de transferência bancária por e-mail.** Ligue para o escritório de fechamento em um número que você mesmo pesquisou — não o que está impresso no e-mail — e verifique cada dígito.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## 3줄 정리

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. Uma relação de representação — e o dever de proteger seus interesses — começa com um contrato assinado de venda ou de representação do comprador, não com um aperto de mão.

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. A comissão é negociável por lei, paga à *imobiliária* e dividida a partir dali; desde agosto de 2024, ela é negociada dentro da transação, em vez de ser anunciada no MLS.

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. A maioria dos desastres na corretagem são problemas de papelada evitáveis: dupla representação não divulgada, defeitos materiais não documentados por escrito e instruções de transferência não confirmadas por telefone.

segments.src: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈
segments.tr: ## ✅ 셀프 퀴즈

segments.src: **Q1.** You sign a 6-month **exclusive right to sell** listing.
segments.tr: **Q1.** Você assina um contrato de **exclusive right to sell** de 6 meses.

segments.src: In month 3 you find a buyer entirely on your own.
segments.tr: No mês 3, você encontra um comprador totalmente por conta própria.

segments.src: Does the listing broker earn a commission?
segments.tr: A imobiliária contratada tem direito à comissão?

segments.src: - (A) Yes, the full negotiated commission
segments.tr: - (A) Sim, a comissão integral negociada

segments.src: - (B) No, because the broker didn't produce the buyer
segments.tr: - (B) Não, porque o corretor não trouxe o comprador

segments.src: - (C) Only half, automatically
segments.tr: - (C) Apenas metade, automaticamente

segments.src: (O/X)** Since the August 2024 practice changes, U.S.
segments.tr: (O/X)** Desde as mudanças de prática de agosto de 2024, as comissões imobiliárias nos EUA

segments.src: real estate commissions follow a standard national rate set by the industry.
segments.tr: seguem uma taxa nacional padrão definida pelo setor.

segments.src: **Q3.** Two days before closing you receive an email from your title company with new wire instructions.
segments.tr: **Q3.** Dois dias antes do fechamento, você recebe um e-mail da sua empresa de títulos com novas instruções de transferência bancária.

segments.src: What's the correct move?
segments.tr: Qual é a atitude correta?

segments.src: - (A) Reply to the email asking them to confirm
segments.tr: - (A) Responder ao e-mail pedindo para confirmarem

segments.src: - (B) Call the title company at a number you independently verified and confirm the instructions
segments.tr: - (B) Ligar para a empresa de títulos em um número que você verificou de forma independente e confirmar as instruções

segments.src: - (C) Wire a small test amount first, then the rest
segments.tr: - (C) Transferir um pequeno valor de teste primeiro, e depois o restante

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
segments.tr: - **Listing agreement** — O contrato escrito no qual um vendedor contrata uma imobiliária para comercializar o imóvel, definindo o prazo, o preço e a remuneração.

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell** — O tipo de contrato de venda onde a imobiliária é paga em qualquer venda durante o prazo, independentemente de quem encontrou o comprador.

segments.src: - **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
segments.tr: - **Buyer representation agreement** — O contrato escrito que contrata uma imobiliária para representar um comprador; obrigatório antes de visitar imóveis com um corretor participante do MLS a partir de August 17, 2024.

segments.src: - **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
segments.tr: - **Fiduciary duty** — As obrigações legais do corretor para com o cliente: lealdade, confidencialidade, obediência, divulgação, cuidado razoável e prestação de contas.

segments.src: - **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
segments.tr: - **Dual agency** — Uma única imobiliária representando tanto o comprador quanto o vendedor; permitido apenas com consentimento prévio por escrito e informado em alguns estados, e proibido em outros.

segments.src: - **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.
segments.tr: - **E&O insurance** — Cobertura de erros e omissões que protege as imobiliárias contra reclamações de negligência profissional ou declarações falsas.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — (A).** "Exclusive right to sell" means the commission is earned on any sale during the term; a seller who wants a carve-out for self-found buyers needs an exclusive agency listing or a negotiated exclusion clause written into the contract.
segments.tr: *Resposta: **Q1 — (A).** "Exclusive right to sell" significa que a comissão é devida em qualquer venda durante o prazo do contrato; um vendedor que deseja uma exceção para compradores encontrados por conta própria precisa de um contrato de "exclusive agency" ou de uma cláusula de exclusão negociada e escrita no contrato.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** Rates have never been standardized — setting or suggesting a uniform rate is price fixing under antitrust law.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (Falso).** As taxas nunca foram padronizadas — definir ou sugerir uma taxa uniforme é fixação de preços sob a lei antitruste.

segments.src: The 2024 changes removed compensation offers from the MLS and required written buyer agreements; they did not create a standard rate.
segments.tr: As mudanças de 2024 removeram as ofertas de remuneração do MLS e exigiram contratos escritos com compradores; elas não criaram uma taxa padrão.

segments.src: **Q3 — (B).** Fraudulent wire instructions arrive from spoofed or compromised email accounts, so replying only reaches the attacker.
segments.tr: **Q3 — (B).** Instruções de transferência fraudulentas chegam de contas de e-mail falsificadas ou invadidas, de modo que responder apenas alcançará o invasor.

segments.src: Verify by voice at an independently sourced number; a "test wire" still sends real money to a criminal account.*
segments.tr: Confirme por voz em um número obtido de forma independente; uma "transferência de teste" ainda envia dinheiro real para uma conta criminosa.*

segments.src: *This is general educational content, not legal advice.
segments.tr: *Este é um conteúdo educacional geral, não aconselhamento jurídico.

segments.src: Agency rules, dual agency legality, and disclosure requirements are set state by state — check your state's real estate commission before you sign.*
segments.tr: As regras de representação, a legalidade da dupla representação e os requisitos de divulgação são definidos estado por estado — consulte a comissão de corretagem imobiliária do seu estado antes de assinar.*

in.title: [Real Estate 101 #13] Siapa yang Sebenarnya Membayar Agen Anda — dan Apa yang Secara Hukum Harus Mereka Berikan Kepada Anda

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > Pekerjaan seorang agen estat real didefinisikan oleh tiga dokumen dan satu tanda tangan: perjanjian yang mempekerjakan mereka, klausul yang membayar mereka, dan pengungkapan yang menjaga semua orang agar tidak masuk ke pengadilan.

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: Banyak orang bertemu dengan agen estat real seperti mereka bertemu dengan pelayan resto — seseorang yang ramah muncul, menunjukkan berbagai hal kepada Anda, dan sebuah tagihan muncul di akhir.

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: Model mental itu salah, dan itu adalah sumber dari hampir setiap keluhan yang diajukan ke komisi estat real negara bagian.

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: Praktik pialang bertumpu pada tiga pilar.

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: Perjanjian yang menciptakan hubungan tersebut.**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: Seorang agen tidak mewakili Anda hanya karena mereka bersikap baik kepada Anda.

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: Mereka mewakili Anda karena Anda menandatangani sesuatu.

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: Di sisi penjual itu adalah **listing agreement** (perjanjian pendaftaran); di sisi pembeli, sebuah **buyer representation agreement** (perjanjian perwakilan pembeli).

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: Di sebagian besar negara bagian, ini harus dibuat secara tertulis agar dapat diberlakukan (sebuah konsekuensi dari *statute of frauds*), dan harus mencantumkan tanggal kedaluwarsa yang pasti — tidak ada kontrak tanpa batas waktu.

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: Listing hadir dalam beberapa jenis, dan perbedaannya bernilai uang yang nyata:

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell** — pialang terdaftar dibayar jika rumah terjual selama jangka waktu tersebut, *tidak peduli siapa yang menemukan pembeli*, termasuk sepupu penjual sendiri. Ini adalah listing standar di AS.

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive agency** — pialang dibayar hanya jika pialang (atau agen lain) membawa pembeli. Jika penjual menemukan pembeli sendiri, tidak ada komisi.

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **Open listing** — penjual dapat menyewa banyak pialang; hanya pialang yang membawa pembeli yang dibayar. Jarang terjadi pada properti hunian.

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: Klausul kompensasi.**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: Komisi bersifat *selalu dapat dinegosiasikan, dan menurut hukum harus demikian.* Tidak ada negara bagian, tidak ada asosiasi, dan tidak ada MLS yang boleh menetapkan atau menyarankan tarif standar — melakukan hal itu adalah penetapan harga berdasarkan hukum antimonopoli federal.

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: Yang bervariasi adalah siapa membayar siapa, dan sejak perubahan praktik penyelesaian National Association of Realtors berlaku pada **17 Agustus 2024**, dua hal berubah secara nasional: penawaran kompensasi kepada agen pembeli tidak lagi dapat dipublikasikan di MLS, dan agen yang merupakan peserta MLS harus memiliki perjanjian tertulis yang ditandatangani dengan pembeli *sebelum* melakukan tur rumah bersama mereka.

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: Penjual masih dapat menyetujui untuk menanggung agen pembeli — ini sekarang hanya dinegosiasikan dalam kesepakatan daripada diiklankan di feed listing.

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: Kewajiban, dan cara agen dituntut.**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: Ketika seorang agen mewakili Anda sebagai agen (bukan sebagai fasilitator netral), mereka memiliki **fiduciary duties** (kewajiban fiduciari): kesetiaan, kerahasiaan, kepatuhan pada instruksi yang sah, pengungkapan fakta material, kehati-hatian yang wajar, dan pertanggungjawaban atas uang yang dipegang.

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: Komisi adalah bagian yang menyenangkan dari pekerjaan ini; kewajiban-kewajiban inilah yang dapat memicu tuntutan hukum.

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: Kegagalan berulang yang terjadi sangat konsisten: tidak mengungkapkan cacat material yang diketahui, mempraktikkan hukum atau penilaian tanpa lisensi ("jangan khawatir, hak guna lintas/easement itu baik-baik saja"), penanganan uang muka yang ceroboh, dan **undisclosed dual agency** — mewakili kedua belah pihak tanpa persetujuan tertulis yang didasari informasi memadai.

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: Beberapa negara bagian menganggap konflik tersebut tidak dapat dikelola dan melarang agen ganda secara langsung; Florida dan Colorado, misalnya, menggunakan model **transaction broker** yang netral.

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: Inilah sebabnya pialang memiliki **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** dan mengapa berkas — setiap pesan teks, setiap pengungkapan, setiap adendum yang ditandatangani — adalah pertahanan nyata sang agen.

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: Katakanlah Anda menjual rumah bandar di Raleigh, North Carolina seharga **$425,000**.

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: Anda menandatangani listing exclusive right to sell selama 6 bulan dengan kesepakatan **total komisi 5%**, dengan perjanjian listing yang memberi wewenang kepada Anda untuk menawarkan **2,5%** kepada agen pembeli jika ada agen pembeli yang terlibat.

segments.src: At closing:
segments.tr: Saat penutupan (closing):

segments.src: Sale price                 $425,000
segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000

segments.src: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250
segments.tr: Total commission (5%)      $ 21,250

segments.src: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625
segments.tr: Listing brokerage 2.5%   $ 10,625

segments.src: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625
segments.tr: Buyer brokerage 2.5%     $ 10,625

segments.src: That $10,625 does not go to your agent.
segments.tr: Uang sebesar $10,625 itu tidak diberikan kepada agen Anda.

segments.src: It goes to the **broker**, who splits it with the agent under their internal agreement — a 50/50 new-agent split leaves $5,312.50 before franchise fees, MLS dues, marketing costs, and self-employment tax.
segments.tr: Uang itu diberikan kepada **pialang**, yang akan membaginya dengan agen berdasarkan perjanjian internal mereka — pembagian 50/50 untuk agen baru menyisakan $5,312.50 sebelum biaya waralaba, iuran MLS, biaya pemasaran, dan pajak usaha mandiri.

segments.src: Understanding this changes how you negotiate: you're negotiating with a business that has a cost floor, not with a person pocketing $21,250.
segments.tr: Memahami hal ini mengubah cara Anda bernegosiasi: Anda bernegosiasi dengan bisnis yang memiliki batas bawah biaya, bukan dengan seseorang yang mengantongi $21,250 secara pribadi.

segments.src: Now the parts that actually bite.
segments.tr: Sekarang bagian yang benar-benar berpengaruh.

segments.src: **Month 4:** your neighbor offers to buy directly.
segments.tr: **Bulan ke-4:** tetangga Anda menawarkan untuk membeli secara langsung.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive right to sell*, your broker is still owed the commission.
segments.tr: Di bawah *exclusive right to sell*, pialang Anda tetap berhak menerima komisi.

segments.src: Under an *exclusive agency* listing, they aren't.
segments.tr: Di bawah listing *exclusive agency*, mereka tidak berhak.

segments.src: One word in a contract you skimmed, $21,250 of difference.
segments.tr: Satu kata dalam kontrak yang Anda baca sekilas membuat perbedaan sebesar $21,250.

segments.src: **Month 5:** your agent brings a buyer they also represent.
segments.tr: **Bulan ke-5:** agen Anda membawa pembeli yang juga mereka wakili.

segments.src: In North Carolina that's legal only with the prior written consent of both parties, and the agent must stop advising either side on price and terms.
segments.tr: Di North Carolina, hal itu legal hanya dengan persetujuan tertulis sebelumnya dari kedua belah pihak, dan agen harus berhenti menasihati kedua belah pihak mengenai harga dan ketentuan.

segments.src: If they never asked — that's a license complaint.
segments.tr: Jika mereka tidak pernah meminta izin — itu adalah bentuk pelanggaran lisensi.

segments.src: **Closing day:** you get an email that looks exactly like your closing attorney's, with updated wire instructions and a "please hurry" note.
segments.tr: **Hari penutupan:** Anda menerima email yang terlihat persis seperti email pengacara penutupan Anda, berisi instruksi transfer kawat yang diperbarui dan catatan "tolong cepat".

segments.src: This is the single most expensive mistake in modern residential real estate.
segments.tr: Ini adalah satu-satunya kesalahan termahal dalam estat real hunian modern.

segments.src: The FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center logs thousands of real estate wire fraud complaints a year, with losses in the hundreds of millions of dollars, and wired funds are often unrecoverable within hours.
segments.tr: Internet Crime Complaint Center milik FBI mencatat ribuan keluhan penipuan transfer kawat estat real setiap tahun, dengan kerugian ratusan juta dolar, dan dana yang ditransfer sering kali tidak dapat dipulihkan dalam hitungan jam.

segments.src: **Never accept wire instructions by email.** Call the closing office at a number you looked up yourself — not one printed in the email — and verify every digit.
segments.tr: **Jangan pernah menerima instruksi transfer kawat melalui email.** Telepon kantor penutupan pada nomor yang Anda cari sendiri — bukan nomor yang tercetak di email — dan verifikasi setiap digitnya.

segments.src: ## 3줄 정리
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. An agency relationship — and the duty to protect your interests — begins with a signed listing or buyer representation agreement, not with a handshake.
segments.tr: 1. Hubungan keagenan — dan kewajiban untuk melindungi kepentingan Anda — dimulai dengan lisensi/perjanjian listing atau perwakilan pembeli yang ditandatangani, bukan dengan berjabat tangan.

segments.src: 2. Commission is negotiable by law, paid to the *broker* and split from there; since August 2024 it's negotiated inside the transaction rather than advertised on the MLS.
segments.tr: 2. Komisi dapat dinegosiasikan secara hukum, dibayarkan kepada *pialang* dan dibagi dari sana; sejak Agustus 2024, komisi dinegosiasikan di dalam transaksi, bukan diiklankan di MLS.

segments.src: 3. Most brokerage disasters are preventable paperwork problems: undisclosed dual agency, unwritten material defects, and wire instructions verified by phone.
segments.tr: 3. Sebagian besar bencana kepialangan adalah masalah dokumen yang sebenarnya dapat dicegah: dual agency yang tidak diungkapkan, cacat material yang tidak tertulis, dan instruksi transfer kawat yang diverifikasi melalui telepon.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri

segments.tr: - (B) Tidak, karena pialang tidak membawa pembeli tersebut

segments.tr: - (C) Hanya setengahnya, secara otomatis

segments.tr: **Q3.** Dua hari sebelum penutupan Anda menerima email dari perusahaan hak milik (title company) Anda dengan instruksi transfer kawat yang baru.

segments.src: ## 📚 오늘의 용어
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini

segments.src: - **Listing agreement** — The written contract in which a seller hires a broker to market the property, setting the term, price, and compensation.
segments.tr: - **Listing agreement** — Kontrak tertulis di mana penjual menyewa pialang untuk memasarkan properti, yang menetapkan jangka waktu, harga, dan kompensasi.

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — The listing type where the broker is paid on any sale during the term, regardless of who found the buyer.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell** — Jenis listing di mana pialang dibayar pada setiap penjualan selama jangka waktu tersebut, tanpa memandang siapa yang menemukan pembeli.

segments.src: - **Buyer representation agreement** — The written contract hiring a broker to represent a buyer; required before touring homes with an MLS-participant agent as of August 17, 2024.
segments.tr: - **Buyer representation agreement** — Kontrak tertulis untuk menyewa pialang guna mewakili pembeli; diwajibkan sebelum melakukan tur rumah dengan agen peserta MLS per 17 Agustus 2024.

segments.src: - **Fiduciary duty** — The agent's legal obligations to a client: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience, disclosure, reasonable care, and accounting.
segments.tr: - **Fiduciary duty** — Kewajiban hukum agen kepada klien: kesetiaan, kerahasiaan, kepatuhan, pengungkapan, kehati-hatian yang wajar, dan pertanggungjawaban keuangan.

segments.src: - **Dual agency** — One brokerage representing both buyer and seller; permitted only with written informed consent in some states, and prohibited in others.
segments.tr: - **Dual agency** — Satu pialang yang mewakili pembeli dan penjual; diizinkan hanya dengan persetujuan tertulis yang didasari informasi memadai di beberapa negara bagian, dan dilarang di negara bagian lain.

segments.src: - **E&O insurance** — Errors and omissions coverage protecting brokers against claims of professional negligence or misrepresentation.
segments.tr: - **E&O insurance** — Perlindungan terhadap kesalahan dan kelalaian (errors and omissions) yang melindungi pialang dari klaim kelalaian profesional atau misrepresentasi.

segments.src: *정답: **Q1 — (A).** "Exclusive right to sell" means the commission is earned on any sale during the term; a seller who wants a carve-out for self-found buyers needs an exclusive agency listing or a negotiated exclusion clause written into the contract.
segments.tr: *Jawaban: **Q1 — (A).** "Exclusive right to sell" berarti komisi diperoleh dari penjualan apa pun selama jangka waktu tersebut; penjual yang menginginkan pengecualian untuk pembeli yang ditemukan sendiri memerlukan listing exclusive agency atau klausul pengecualian yang dinegosiasikan dan ditulis dalam kontrak.

segments.src: **Q2 — X (False).** Rates have never been standardized — setting or suggesting a uniform rate is price fixing under antitrust law.
segments.tr: **Q2 — X (Salah).** Tarif tidak pernah distandardisasi — menetapkan atau menyarankan tarif seragam adalah penetapan harga berdasarkan hukum antimonopoli.

segments.src: The 2024 changes removed compensation offers from the MLS and required written buyer agreements; they did not create a standard rate.
segments.tr: Perubahan 2024 menghapus penawaran kompensasi dari MLS dan mewajibkan perjanjian pembeli tertulis; perubahan tersebut tidak membuat tarif standar.

segments.src: **Q3 — (B).** Fraudulent wire instructions arrive from spoofed or compromised email accounts, so replying only reaches the attacker.
segments.tr: **Q3 — (B).** Instruksi transfer kawat yang palsu berasal dari akun email yang dipalsukan atau diretas, sehingga membalas email hanya akan sampai ke peretas.

segments.src: Verify by voice at an independently sourced number; a "test wire" still sends real money to a criminal account.*
segments.tr: Verifikasi melalui suara pada nomor yang diperoleh secara independen; "transfer uji coba" tetap saja mengirimkan uang asli ke akun kriminal.*

segments.tr: Aturan keagenan, legalitas dual agency, dan persyaratan pengungkapan ditetapkan oleh masing-masing negara bagian — periksa komisi estat real di negara bagian Anda sebelum Anda menandatangani.*

ja.title: [不動産入門 #13] エージェントへの報酬は誰が支払うのか？そして法律上彼らがあなたに負う義務とは

segments.src: > A real estate agent's job is defined by three documents and one signature: the agreement that hires them, the clause that pays them, and the disclosures that keep everyone out of court.
segments.tr: > 不動産エージェントの仕事は、3つの文書と1つの署名によって定義されます。彼らを雇う契約書、報酬を支払う条項、そして全員を裁判沙汰から守る情報開示です。

segments.src: ## 오늘의 개념
segments.tr: ## 本日の概念

segments.src: Most people meet a real estate agent the way they meet a waiter — someone friendly shows up, shows you things, and a bill appears at the end.
segments.tr: 多くの人は、給仕係に出会うのと同じような感覚で不動産エージェントに出会います。愛想の良い人物が現れ、物件を案内し、最後に請求書が出てくる、という流れです。

segments.src: That mental model is wrong, and it's the source of nearly every complaint filed with a state real estate commission.
segments.tr: しかし、その考え方は誤りであり、州の不動産委員会に寄せられる苦情のほぼすべての原因となっています。

segments.src: Brokerage practice rests on three pillars.
segments.tr: 不動産仲介の慣行は、3つの柱に基づいています。

segments.src: The agreement that creates the relationship.**
segments.tr: 関係を構築する契約**

segments.src: An agent does not represent you because they were nice to you.
segments.tr: エージェントは、あなたに親切にしてくれたからという理由であなたを代理するわけではありません。

segments.src: They represent you because you signed something.
segments.tr: あなたが何らかの書類に署名したからこそ、あなたを代理するのです。

segments.src: On the seller's side that's a **listing agreement**; on the buyer's side, a **buyer representation agreement**.
segments.tr: 売主側ではこれが **Listing agreement（専任媒介・専任売却契約など）** であり、買主側では **Buyer representation agreement（買主代理契約）** となります。

segments.src: In most states these must be in writing to be enforceable (a consequence of the *statute of frauds*), and they must state a definite expiration date — no open-ended contracts.
segments.tr: ほとんどの州では、これらが法的強制力を持つためには書面で作成されている必要があり（*詐欺防止法（Statute of Frauds）* による影響）、明確な有効期限が定められていなければなりません（無期限の契約は不可）。

segments.src: Listings come in flavors, and the difference is worth real money:
segments.tr: リスティング（媒介契約）にはいくつかの種類があり、その違いは現実のお金に直結します。

segments.src: - **Exclusive right to sell** — the listing broker is paid if the home sells during the term, *no matter who finds the buyer*, including the seller's own cousin. This is the standard listing in the U.S.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive right to sell（専任・専属媒介契約）** — 契約期間中に住宅が売却された場合、*誰が買主を見つけたかに関わらず*（売主のいとこが見つけた場合であっても）、リスティングブローカーに報酬が支払われます。これが米国における標準的なリスティングです。

segments.src: - **Exclusive agency** — the broker is paid only if the broker (or another agent) produces the buyer. If the seller finds the buyer alone, no commission.
segments.tr: - **Exclusive agency（専任媒介契約の一種）** — ブローカー（または別のエージェント）が買主を見つけた場合にのみ報酬が支払われます。売主が自分だけで買主を見つけた場合、手数料は発生しません。

segments.src: - **Open listing** — the seller can hire many brokers; only the one who produces the buyer gets paid. Rare in residential.
segments.tr: - **Open listing（一般媒介契約）** — 売主は多数のブローカーを雇うことができ、買主を見つけたブローカーだけに報酬が支払われます。住宅取引では稀です。

segments.src: The compensation clause.**
segments.tr: 報酬条項**

segments.src: Commission is *negotiable, always, and by law it has to be.* No state, no association, and no MLS may set or suggest a standard rate — doing so is price fixing under federal antitrust law.
segments.tr: 手数料は *常に交渉可能であり、法律によってそうでなければなりません。* いかなる州、協会、MLS（複数売り出しサービス）も標準レートを設定または提案することはできず、それを行うことは連邦反トラスト法の下で価格カルテルとみなされます。

segments.src: What varies is who pays whom, and since the National Association of Realtors' settlement practice changes took effect on **August 17, 2024**, two things changed nationally: offers of compensation to buyer's agents can no longer be published on an MLS, and an agent who is an MLS participant must have a signed written agreement with a buyer *before* touring a home with them.
segments.tr: 変化するのは「誰が誰に支払うか」です。全米リアルター協会（NAR）の和解に伴う慣行変更が **2024年8月17日** に施行されて以来、全国的に2つの点が変更されました。買主側エージェントへの報酬のオファーをMLS上に掲載することが禁止されたこと、そしてMLS参加者であるエージェントは、買主と一緒に物件を見学する *前* に、買主と署名済みの書面による契約を結ばなければならなくなったことです。

segments.src: Sellers can still agree to cover the buyer's agent — it's just negotiated in the deal now rather than advertised in the listing feed.
segments.tr: 売主が買主側エージェントの費用を負担することに同意することは現在も可能ですが、それはリスティングのフィードに掲載されるのではなく、個別取引の中で交渉されることになりました。

segments.src: The duties, and the ways agents get sued.**
segments.tr: 義務、そしてエージェントが訴えられる原因**

segments.src: When an agent represents you as an agent (rather than as a neutral facilitator), they owe **fiduciary duties**: loyalty, confidentiality, obedience to lawful instructions, disclosure of material facts, reasonable care, and accounting for money held.
segments.tr: エージェントが（中立的なファシリテーターとしてではなく）エージェントとしてあなたを代理する場合、彼らは **Fiduciary duties（受託者責任／忠実義務）** を負います。これには、忠実義務、守秘義務、合法的指示への服従、重要事項の開示、合理的注意、預かり金の会計管理が含まれます。

segments.src: Commissions are the fun part of the job; these duties are the part that generates lawsuits.
segments.tr: 手数料は仕事の楽しい部分ですが、これらの義務は訴訟を生み出す部分です。

segments.src: The recurring failure modes are boringly consistent: not disclosing a known material defect, practicing law or appraisal without a license ("don't worry, that easement is fine"), sloppy handling of earnest money, and **undisclosed dual agency** — representing both sides without written informed consent.
segments.tr: 繰り返し発生する失敗のパターンは退屈なほど一貫しています。既知の重要な欠陥を開示しないこと、無資格で法律実務や不動産鑑定を行うこと（「心配いりません、その地役権は問題ありません」など）、手付金のずさんな管理、そして **Undisclosed dual agency（未開示の双方代理）** — 書面によるインフォームドコンセントなしに双方を代理することです。

segments.src: Some states have decided the conflict is unmanageable and banned dual agency outright; Florida and Colorado, for example, use a neutral **transaction broker** model instead.
segments.tr: 一部の州では、この利益相反は管理不可能だと判断し、双方代理を全面的に禁止しています。たとえばフロリダ州やコロラド州では、代わりに中立的な **Transaction broker（取引ブローカー）** モデルが使用されています。

segments.src: This is why brokerages carry **errors and omissions (E&O) insurance** and why the file — every text, every disclosure, every signed addendum — is the agent's real defense.
segments.tr: これこそが、仲介業者が **Errors and omissions (E&O) insurance（職業上の過失受託者賠償責任保険）** に加入する理由であり、ファイル（あらゆるテキスト、あらゆる開示文書、あらゆる署名済み添え状）がエージェントの本当の防衛策となる理由です。

segments.src: ## 일상 속에서
segments.tr: ## 日常生活の中で

segments.src: Say you're selling a townhouse in Raleigh, North Carolina for **$425,000**.
segments.tr: たとえば、あなたがノースカロライナ州ローリーにあるタウンハウスを **$425,000** で売却するとします。

segments.src: You sign a 6-month exclusive right to sell listing at a negotiated **5% total commission**, with your listing agreement authorizing you to offer **2.5%** to a buyer's agent if a buyer's agent is involved.
segments.tr: あなたは交渉により **総手数料5%** の6ヶ月間のExclusive right to sell（専任売却契約）に署名し、買主側エージェントが関与している場合にはそのエージェントに **2.5%** をオファーすることをリスティング契約書で許可します。

segments.tr: Sale price                 $425,000
